mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (4.29%) is below 5%, and historically such low rates have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion (HOUST > 2000), consumer confidence and economic activity strengthen, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 2000 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: The current housing starts (1994.0) are below 2000, and historically such low levels have been associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 2000 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 135000, it signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 2000 AND PAYEMS > 135000 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
